item.title: Judge temporarily halts construction of Trump's White House ballroom
item.summary: The Republican-appointed judge ruled that Trump was a "steward" of the White House, not the owner.

item.title: US could 'finish the job' in Iran in two or three weeks, Trump says
item.summary: President Trump says the US will "leave" Iran "very soon" as Iran's president says Tehran has the "necessary will" to end the war.

item.title: My daughter has childhood dementia and may not live past 16
item.summary: Diagnosed just before her fourth birthday, Sophia, now 15, can no longer speak and cannot walk unaided.

item.title: Minimum wage rises to £12.71 an hour as firms warn of impact
item.summary: Many businesses have said they will have to pass higher wage costs onto customers.

item.title: Dissident groups still have 'capacity and desire' to attack police, says NI justice minister
item.summary: Naomi Long says despite their small numbers those involved are "wedded" to destruction and violence.

item.title: Weight-loss jabs will be offered on NHS for people at risk of further heart attacks
item.summary: More than a million people in England will start being offered the anti-obesity jab for better heart health and to avoid strokes.

item.title: 'Afro hair care workshops are about more than styling, they're about belonging'
item.summary: Natalie Edwards says "hair is part of identity" and more needs to be done to teach these skills.

item.title: Diplomatic challenges facing King on US visit in shadow of war and Epstein
item.summary: King Charles will be expected to improve UK and US relations on his state visit next month.

item.title: Energy bill help would be based on household income, Reeves says
item.summary: The chancellor tells the BBC it is "too early" to say exactly who would get help but hinted any support would not arrive until the autumn.

item.title: Watch Carol Kirkwood's emotional goodbye and funniest moments as she leaves the BBC
item.summary: As the BBC weather presenter bids farewell after 25 years, we take you through some of her best moments on screen.
